analysis:
This batch adds a local add-on hold subsystem under provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/Addon/. It covers the hold.v1 socket protocol, peer authentication, the persisted hold record, machine-lock observation, telemetry and the operator control request. No prompt, key or attestation data crosses this interface. Telemetry (AddonHoldTelemetry.swift:31-36) logs only the transition, add-on identifier, state, lease length and in-flight count.

Authentication:
- AddonPeerPolicy.swift requires an equal EUID and the kernel LOCAL_PEERTOKEN audit token.
- It then requires SecCodeCheckValidity against a Developer ID requirement pinned to team SLDQ2GJ6TL, plus matching identifier/team and the hardened-runtime flag.
- The DEBUG-only extra identity is compiled out of release builds.
- AddonIPCServer.swift:186-190 re-authenticates the peer on every request.

Filesystem handling:
- AddonHoldStore uses O_NOFOLLOW, fstat owner/mode checks, a 64 KiB cap and O_EXCL temp files with atomic rename.
- AddonRuntimeDirectory.prepare (AddonHoldPaths.swift:54-65) refuses symlinks and foreign-owned directories.
- The socket is bound 0600 and a live socket is never taken over.
- AddonMachineLock.observe fails toward 'held'.

Observed residuals; same-UID is the operator domain (ADV-001/TB-003), so none was flagged:
- The DARKBLOOM_ADDON_SOCKET override, documented as test-only, is honored in release builds and relocates the hold record and machine lock (AddonHoldPaths.swift:32-35).
- Any same-UID process can occupy all 8 pre-authentication connection slots for up to 300 s, because authentication happens only on the first line (AddonIPCServer.swift:128-131,170).
- A handler that times out at 30 s still runs detached and may apply its effect after an 'unavailable' reply (AddonIPCServer.swift:199-211).
- vm_bytes is unbounded at parse time (AddonIPC.swift:48,75).

Questions for integration (handler and callers not in this batch):
- How do holds gate admission, model loading and cancellation of in-flight inference, and is drain fail-closed? Relevant to T-010 and T-029.
- How are hold state and busy_addon reported to the coordinator in register/heartbeat? A hold must not affect authorization or attestation (TB-011, T-053).
- Is the lifecycle mailbox AddonHoldControlRequest bound to ProcessIdentity correctly?
- Are restored holds from addon-hold.json bounded and lease-expired?
- Is server stop() always called?
- Does the threat model or docs add a boundary for the add-on IPC and VM co-residence? Any VM beside decrypted prompt memory touches TB-003/TB-007 and T-028.
